name: MH3G #32 hot/cold drink timer-pair candidates
purpose_zh: 验证每帧更新函数中的两组玩家浮点计时器：+0x974/+0x978 与 +0x980/+0x984。通过高温和低温各一次受控饮用，确定哪组对应热饮、哪组对应冷饮。只记录，不修改。
purpose_en: Prove the two player float-timer pairs in the per-frame updater, +0x974/+0x978 and +0x980/+0x984. Use one controlled drink in a hot area and one in a cold area to identify which pair is hot-drink versus cold-drink state. Record only; do not modify state.
operator_steps_zh: 第一次在明确高温且未受保护的任务中记录饮用前状态，启动 tracer 后只喝一次对应饮料；第二次在明确低温任务用全新输出文件重复。
每次保持同一装备、技能和猫饭，不换区，不同时使用笛、旋律或其他环境免疫效果。
两个断点都应命中；比较饮用前后四个大端 float，仅当一组当前/前值按饮料效果上升并随后按环境速率递减，另一组保持符合环境逻辑时，才标注热/冷身份并升级。
operator_steps_en: First record pre-drink state in a clearly hot unprotected quest, start the tracer, and consume only the matching drink. Repeat with a fresh output file in a clearly cold quest.
Keep equipment, skills, and food constant; do not change areas or use horns, melodies, or other environmental immunity effects concurrently.

Both breakpoints should hit. Compare all four big-endian floats before and after drinking; label hot/cold identity and promote only when one current/previous pair rises with the drink then decreases at the environmental rate while the other follows the expected environment logic.
